chunks: Then proceed to al-Safa and do there as you did on the day you arrived in Makkah. Perform the movement between them in seven circuits, beginning with al-Safa and ending with al-Marwah. When you have done that, you have exited the restrictions of ihram from everything for which you had entered ihram, except women.

key_terms.أَحْرَمْتَ: you had entered into the state of ihram
key_terms.أَحْلَلْتَ: you have become released from the restrictions of ihram
key_terms.سَبْعَةَ أَشْوَاطٍ: seven rounds or circuits of the ritual movement
key_terms.ٱلصَّفَا: Al-Safa, the hill from which the sa'i begins
key_terms.ٱلنِّسَاءَ: women, meaning marital relations remain prohibited at this stage
key_terms.ٱلْمَرْوَةِ: Al-Marwah, the hill at which the sa'i concludes

ai.seo_question: What happens after completing sa'i between al-Safa and al-Marwah in hajj?
ai.summary: This passage gives a legal instruction for the sa'i between al-Safa and al-Marwah during hajj rites. It explains the order of the ritual, the number of circuits, and that completing it lifts the restrictions of ihram except for relations with women.
